resolutions.what_changed: The line-anchored regex `^\s*norm\s*=[^=]` over a text window is replaced by `_binds()`, an `ast` walk counting `Name(id='norm', ctx=Store)` nodes inside the named function. Every binding form Python has — plain, chained, same-line-after-semicolon, augmented, walrus, tuple unpack, for-target — is one Store node, so the guard now enforces the property four artifacts already claimed for it instead of a line shape. Keys are function names rather than `def` lines, which also deletes the end-of-function text scan and with it the decorator-keying defect that scan carried in-session. [Corrected in round 3, PR #54 R9: that defect was caught and fixed inside round 1 and never committed — the round-1 shipped code at e633b99 keys on the `def` line and its window is correct. R9 named two locations for this false 'shipped' claim; this artifact was a third.] Innocent formatting was checked and is unaffected: the real app.py binds `norm` exactly once in each function and is green unmodified.
